headline: Replay calibration night: the remaining gaps are understood (loss halts on a knife edge, stop fills ~0.045R worse live); a spread-based stop-slip model goes in next, then a fresh, unaided rule-21 audit after the 11-12 close.
bullets: Live stop exits fill a mean +0.045R past the stop in every account, driven by entry spread vs stop distance (slip = 0.012 + 0.34 x spread/stop).
Graveyard's -2R latch flips on hundredths of R, so replays only agree if stop fills match; the slip model should make that work for names live didn't trade too.
A buying-power cap in the simulator was tried and rejected - it put rejects on the wrong days.
Data trap: 'stop' exits after a moved (breakeven/trailing) stop keep the original stop price; checklist item 34 handles it.
Per-setup effective trades (shrunk ICC) table ready for the owner on 11-18.
next: Stop-slip model in the replay; after the 11-12 close: fresh rule-21 audit (no live feeds), NEWSMID, FAMC session 2.
